name: When a scale contains both a minor 3rd and a major 3rd, the major 3rd functions as the actual 3r
use_when: Ngẫu hứng jazz trên hợp âm C7b9
Ngẫu hứng jazz trên hợp âm C13b9#9#11
Chọn gam / scale khi gặp hợp âm 7b9, 13b9#9#11 trong nhạc jazz
avoid_when: Đệm hát ballad Việt — đây là gam jazz, không phải bài của thầy Hải Joseph

output.source_text: When a scale contains both a minor 3rd and a major 3rd, the major 3rd functions as the actual 3rd of the dominant chord, while the minor 3rd is re-interpreted as a #9 extension. Building a chord in 3rds from the C half-whole scale yields C (1), E (3), G (5), Bb (b7), Db (b9), D# (#9), F# (#11), A (13) -> C13b9#9#11 (commonly written as C7b9).

note_vi: Bài 28 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 03:13-04:40. When a scale contains both a minor 3rd and a major 3rd, the major 3rd functions as the actual 3rd of the dominant chord, while the minor 3rd is re-interpreted as a #9 extension. Building a chord in 3rds from the C half-whole scale yields C (1), E (3), G (5), Bb (b7), Db (b9), D# (#9), F# (#11), A (13) -> C13b9#9#11 (commonly written as C7b9). Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng. Item còn draft: chưa ai xem lại video để đối chiếu.
